# `GenerationErrorException`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\GenerationErrorException`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/GenerationErrorException.php#L23) — **Version:** working tree

**Extends:** `RuntimeException`

**Implements:** `Throwable`, `Stringable`, [`PropertyTestingException`](/api/classes/PropertyTestingException)

Thrown out of [`Runner\PropertyRunner`](/api/classes/Runner/PropertyRunner)::run()
when a generator itself throws while producing an input — a bug in a
`Gen::map()`/`flatMap()` closure, a class constructor rejecting a drawn
value — so the failure still names the seed and the attempt that reproduce it.

It is not a property outcome: the body never ran on that input, so there is
nothing to shrink and no [`Runner\PropertyResult`](/api/classes/Runner/PropertyResult)
to return. The generator's own exception is [`GenerationErrorException`](/api/classes/GenerationErrorException)::getPrevious().
[`GenerationExhaustedException`](/api/classes/GenerationExhaustedException) keeps its own clean result
([`Runner\GenerationFailed`](/api/classes/Runner/GenerationFailed)) and never ends up here.

## Constructor

```php
__construct(
    string $propertyName,
    int $seed,
    int $attempt,
    \Throwable $previous,
)
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$propertyName` | `string` | *required* | The property whose input could not be generated. |
| `$seed` | `int` | *required* | The seed of the phase that drew the input; replaying it reproduces the error. |
| `$attempt` | `int` | *required* | The 1-based attempt the input was drawn for. |
| `$previous` | `Throwable` | *required* | What the generator threw. |
